# 项目: schema_semantic_constrained_ie

## 运行环境
- 服务器名: westd-16980
- SSH 连接命令: ssh westd-16980  # 必须用此命令，~/.ssh/config 自动应用密钥和跳板机，禁止用裸 IP
- 项目代码根目录: /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie


## 环境搭建
连接服务器后先调 `detect_image` 检测是否为预置镜像。如果匹配，跳过基础环境搭建，只装项目特有依赖。已预装的包不要重复安装。

## 输出风格
回复简洁直接。只输出执行结果和必要信息，不要解释过程、不要客套、不要给未被要求的建议。
</project_context>
## 紧急任务: Kill 2048 greedy + 用 4096 重启

### 背景
westd-16980 上正在跑 Qwen greedy unc+con with max_new_tokens=2048，与 Table 2 的 4096 不一致。所有 2048 数据作废。

### 步骤

#### 1. Kill 正在运行的 2048 进程
```bash
# Kill Qwen greedy processes
kill 676441 682762 2>/dev/null
# 确认 kill 成功
sleep 2
ps aux | grep run_constrained | grep -v grep
# 也 kill cascade 脚本（如有）
kill $(ps aux | grep d064_cascade | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}') 2>/dev/null
```

#### 2. 删除所有 2048 输出文件
```bash
# Qwen 2048 输出（不完整）
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d064_qwen_docred_greedy_unconstrained.jsonl
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d064_qwen_docred_greedy_constrained.jsonl
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d064_qwen_greedy_unc.log
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d064_qwen_greedy_con.log
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d064_cascade_qwen_con.log

# Llama 2048 输出（已完成但方法不一致）
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d064_llama_docred_greedy_unconstrained_w5.jsonl
rm -f /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d064_llama_docred_greedy_constrained_w5.jsonl

ls /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d064_*greedy* 2>/dev/null && echo "WARNING: still have d064 greedy files!" || echo "All d064 greedy files cleaned"
```

#### 3. 启动批次 1: Llama greedy unc + con (4096, 同时两卡)
```bash
cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie

# GPU0: Llama greedy unconstrained
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 nohup python run_constrained_extraction.py \
    --mode unconstrained --dataset docred \
    --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/llama_lora_docred_merged \
    --data_path data/docred/dev.json \
    --constraints_path data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json \
    --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_llama_docred_greedy_unc_4096.jsonl \
    --device cuda:0 --max_new_tokens 4096 --seed 42 \
    --decoding_strategy greedy --skip_on_error \
    > /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_llama_greedy_unc.log 2>&1 &
LLAMA_UNC_PID=$!
echo "Llama unc PID: $LLAMA_UNC_PID"

# GPU1: Llama greedy constrained
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 nohup python run_constrained_extraction.py \
    --mode full_s1 --dataset docred \
    --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/llama_lora_docred_merged \
    --data_path data/docred/dev.json \
    --constraints_path data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json \
    --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_llama_docred_greedy_con_4096.jsonl \
    --device cuda:0 --max_new_tokens 4096 --seed 42 \
    --decoding_strategy greedy --skip_on_error \
    > /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_llama_greedy_con.log 2>&1 &
LLAMA_CON_PID=$!
echo "Llama con PID: $LLAMA_CON_PID"
```

#### 4. 创建 cascade 脚本: Llama 完成后自动启动 Qwen
```bash
cat > /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_cascade_qwen.sh << 'CASCADEOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "[$(date)] Waiting for Llama PID $1 (unc) and $2 (con) to finish..."

# Wait for both Llama processes
while kill -0 $1 2>/dev/null || kill -0 $2 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep 60
    echo "[$(date)] Still waiting... Llama unc=$1 con=$2"
done
echo "[$(date)] Llama both done. Starting Qwen..."

# GPU0: Qwen greedy unconstrained
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 nohup python run_constrained_extraction.py \
    --mode unconstrained --dataset docred \
    --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen_lora_docred_merged \
    --data_path data/docred/dev.json \
    --constraints_path data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json \
    --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_qwen_docred_greedy_unc_4096.jsonl \
    --device cuda:0 --max_new_tokens 4096 --seed 42 \
    --decoding_strategy greedy --skip_on_error \
    > /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_qwen_greedy_unc.log 2>&1 &
echo "[$(date)] Qwen unc started PID: $!"

# GPU1: Qwen greedy constrained
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 nohup python run_constrained_extraction.py \
    --mode full_s1 --dataset docred \
    --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen_lora_docred_merged \
    --data_path data/docred/dev.json \
    --constraints_path data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json \
    --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_qwen_docred_greedy_con_4096.jsonl \
    --device cuda:0 --max_new_tokens 4096 --seed 42 \
    --decoding_strategy greedy --skip_on_error \
    > /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_qwen_greedy_con.log 2>&1 &
echo "[$(date)] Qwen con started PID: $!"

echo "[$(date)] All 4 runs launched."
CASCADEOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_cascade_qwen.sh
```

#### 5. 启动 cascade
```bash
nohup bash /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_cascade_qwen.sh $LLAMA_UNC_PID $LLAMA_CON_PID \
    > /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_cascade.log 2>&1 &
echo "Cascade PID: $!"
```

#### 6. 验证
```bash
sleep 10
# 确认进程在跑
ps aux | grep run_constrained | grep -v grep
# 确认 GPU 被使用
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv,noheader
# 确认输出文件创建
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d065_*.jsonl 2>/dev/null
```

### 关键参数对照（必须与 Table 2 w5 runs 一致）
- model_path: llama_lora_docred_merged / qwen_lora_docred_merged
- max_new_tokens: **4096**（不是 2048！）
- seed: 42
- decoding_strategy: greedy
- mode: unconstrained / full_s1
- dataset: docred
- data_path: data/docred/dev.json
- skip_on_error: yes（与 w5 保持一致）

### 预期 ETA
- Llama 998-doc greedy at 4096 tokens: ~3-4h per run (w5 用了 ~3.5h)
- Qwen: similar speed
- 批次 1 完成: ~04:30-05:30 UTC
- 批次 2 完成: ~08:00-09:00 UTC

### 产出
汇报:
1. Kill 确认（进程已停）
2. 文件清理确认
3. 新进程 PID
4. GPU 利用率确认
5. 输出文件名列表

服务器: westd-16980
环境: `source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base`

## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch
